## Risks

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|------|----------|------------|
| `AgentFleetPanel` adds `onStop` / `onTakeover` props — callers need to wire them | Medium | Props are optional; panel renders without them. Wire at `AgentsWindow` level. |
| `CreativeWorkbenchShell` localStorage reads on mount — SSR mismatch possible | Low | `mounted` guard prevents render until client hydration. `DEFAULTS` used for SSR. |
| Three.js codemod annotates but does not migrate — files still have direct imports | Medium | `--write` mode adds `// TODO(three-gateway)` comments. Manual migration of 196 files needed. Use `--verify` in CI to track progress. |
| `WorkbenchPreviewModeHeader` removed `Policy:` pill — callers using `activeSurface.detailPolicy` for UI logic should confirm display-only removal | Low | The policy value is still in `activeSurface.detailPolicy` for programmatic use; only the user-visible text was removed. |
| Film page `FilmStudioClient` uses `CloudStreamStudioClient` which may have its own shell internally | Low | Confirm `CloudStreamStudioClient` accepts an `embedded` prop and does not render its own chrome when embedded. |
